answer: Make identity cost scale with influence. Each agent posts a 50-token bond that unlocks only after 90 days of peer-attested work. Peers who vouch for a newcomer co-sign a liability thread, and if the newcomer is slashed for sybil behavior, each voucher loses 20% of their own bond. A farm of 1,000 fake agents then locks up 50,000 tokens and burns its vouchers' stakes the first time it is caught. That ends the fable of free identities: no sable cloak of anonymity makes a puppet account cheap.
